rows.why: M17 · THE LABEL THE PRODUCT ACTUALLY RENDERS. SaveTemplate.tsx:56-62 passes label="Template Name" to InputField, which reaches FormField.tsx:46 as a real visible <label htmlFor>, styled by labelTheme.ts:42 'tw:text-xs tw:text-[var(--bk-ink-soft)]' — 12px ink-soft, not sr-only and not uppercased. The board carried five texts and no field label at all, so a reviewer could not tell what the field was for once its value was cleared. WHY THIS NEEDED A NEW OP: 1169:4753 is layout=VERTICAL, and add-text does appendChild then sets x/y — in an auto-layout parent the child lands LAST, below `foot`, with its coordinates ignored, so the label would have rendered at the bottom of the modal. insert-text places it at an index instead. Index 1 puts it after the title 1169:4754 ('Save page as template') and before field/name 1169:4755, which is where the family puts a label — see 1170:4713, where field/NAME 1170:4716 contains label 1170:4717 'NAME' directly above its input. Width 428 matches the modal's 460 less its 16px insets. The one value NOT read from the file is the colour: the TSV dumps carry no fills for this node, so #6B7280 is the --bk-ink-soft the code names rather than a sampled paint.

M17 · pay for the inserted row. The board is VERTICAL with itemSpacing 10 and 14px top/bottom padding; its 146 height is exactly its content. A 13px label plus one 10px gap adds 23, so 146 + 23 = 169. Ordering is load-bearing and the applier batches by op: insert-text runs in its own call before resize, so the stack is complete before the board is told how tall to be.
